evidence: Kittle is the only sibling with category 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces' (task.toml category/arena_slice; provenance 'Messaging and chat interfaces package'), matching the assigned domain in handoffs/KITTLE_BUILD_CONTEXT.txt line 12; no other project in projects/*/task.toml occupies that slice except the older-format threadline-chat (category web-development). Compared against threadline-chat (closest sibling: Slack-style channels/DMs/reactions/pins/presence/webhooks/moderation/audit, 20+ criteria in tests/rubric/browser/browser.toml): generic chat mechanics overlap (replies, unread, mentions edit-correction, idempotent send, stale edit), but Kittle's core is law-firm specific and absent from Threadline: ethical walls across every route incl. reply quotes/link previews/mentions/unread and live wall addition (walls-and-retention.md 'Who sees a matter'; criteria wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links, wall_added_live), disappearing-message timers vs fixed clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z with permanent deletion and shortening semantics (timer_changes, deleted_and_expired_messages), partner-only legal hold scoped to one message with release-applies-timer (hold_scope_and_release), and matter transcripts with held-edited version listing (search_and_transcript, transcript_page, transcript_phone). Visual criteria (matter_sidebar, retention_marks, transcript_page, phone_thread) are product-specific, not copied sibling screens. Seed (firm, accounts with Partner/Associate/Client roles, matters M-11/M-12/M-13, timer_options_days, clock) and brief prose ('Kittle & Rowe', clients emailing documents, court connectivity) read as authored; grep of frozen task for threadline/channel/reaction/pinned/presence/webhook/moderator/other sibling names/CHANGE_ME found none except template floor wording 'empty workspace' in judge prompts. Counterexample attempt: a Threadline app with channels renamed to matters would lack walls, timers, holds and transcripts and lose most Functional mass, so the task is not a nouns-swapped clone; no conforming Kittle app fails because of this row.
